sections.changelog:
0.2.0

  • Small icon-only header (matches /manage/'s nav mark), no more oversized custom logo.
  • News homepage rebuilt as hero + featured strip + hub-style river, plus the interactive Game-of-the-Week/other-games swap.
  • Removed commenting entirely (native WP comments); added a self-hosted update checker (this file) so future versions show up as a normal WordPress "Update Available" instead of a manual re-upload.
  • New "Latest Scores" sidebar card on posts/pages.
  • Teams page pulling live franchise/standings data.

0.1.0

  • Initial scaffold.
